Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: OverlapScoreResult

   Structured result from OverlapIndex scoring.

   .. attribute:: macro_score

      Global overlap score.

   .. attribute:: per_class_scores

      Per-class scores returned by OverlapIndex.

   .. attribute:: pairwise_scores

      Pairwise class scores returned by OverlapIndex.

   .. attribute:: sparse_adjacency

      Sparse adjacency diagnostics when available.

   .. attribute:: class_counts

      Counts per class.

   .. attribute:: k_per_class

      Resolved MiniBatchKMeans k per class.

   .. attribute:: warnings

      Scoring warnings.

   .. attribute:: metadata

      Scoring metadata and backend details.


   .. py:method:: to_dict()

      Serialize the score result to a JSON-safe dictionary.

      :returns: JSON-compatible score result.



.. py:function:: auto_k_for_class(n_class, min_k = 10, max_k = 50, min_samples_per_cluster = 5)

   Resolve automatic k for a single class.

   :param n_class: Number of samples in the class.
   :param min_k: Lower target for automatic k resolution.
   :param max_k: Maximum allowed k.
   :param min_samples_per_cluster: Minimum samples expected per cluster.

   :returns: Resolved k value.

   :raises ValueError: If the class has fewer than two samples.


.. py:function:: resolve_kmeans_k(y, config, return_warnings = False)

   Resolve MiniBatchKMeans k values per class.

   :param y: Class labels.
   :param config: Overlap scoring configuration.
   :param return_warnings: Whether to also return warning strings.

   :returns: Mapping from class labels to resolved k values. When `return_warnings`
             is true, returns `(k_per_class, warnings)`.


.. py:class:: OverlapIndexScorer(config = None)

   Internal adapter for MiniBatchKMeans-backed OverlapIndex scoring.

   :param config: Optional scoring configuration.


   .. py:method:: score(Z, y, seed = None)

      Score dense or sparse embeddings with OverlapIndex.

      Sparse embeddings are validated and densified at this boundary because
      the configured OverlapIndex backend consumes dense arrays.

      :param Z: Dense or sparse embedding matrix.
      :param y: Class labels.
      :param seed: Optional random seed forwarded to MiniBatchKMeans.

      :returns: Structured scoring result.

      :raises ImportError: If `overlapindex` is not installed.
      :raises ValueError: If embeddings are invalid or too large to densify.
